map.素数工具是一款科学研究领域的在线工具。科学研究工具，采用标准科学公式，计算精准。: Test whether an integer is prime, generate prime tables in a range, or factorise a number into primes for number theory and coding.
map.素数（质数）是大于 1 的自然数，且只能被 1 和它本身整除。: A prime is a natural number greater than 1 divisible only by 1 and itself.
map.• 最小的素数是 2，也是唯一的偶数素数: • The smallest prime is 2, also the only even prime
map.• 素数有无穷多个（欧几里得定理）: • There are infinitely many primes (Euclid's theorem)
map.• 算术基本定理：每个大于 1 的自然数都能唯一地分解为素数的乘积: • Fundamental theorem of arithmetic: every natural number greater than 1 has a unique prime factorisation
map.• 大素数在现代密码学（如 RSA）中起关键作用: • Large primes play a key role in modern cryptography (e.g. RSA)
map.数论学习与密码学基础中的素数判定演示。: Demonstrate primality testing for number-theory study and cryptography basics.
map.97 不能被 2..√97≈9 的素数整除 → 素数；91=7×13 合数。: 97 is not divisible by primes 2..√97≈9 → prime; 91=7×13 is composite.

map.试除法只适合小数，大数用 Miller-Rabin 等概率算法。: Trial division suits only small numbers; large numbers use probabilistic algorithms such as Miller-Rabin.
map.n 为素数 ⇔ n>1 且不存在 p ∈ [2, √n] 使 p | n: n is prime ⇔ n>1 and no p ∈ [2, √n] divides n
map.素性判定采用试除到 √n（辅以小素数预筛与 6k±1 步进加速）；区间筛法用埃拉: Primality uses trial division up to √n (with small-prime pre-sieving and 6k±1 stepping); range sieving uses the Sieve of Eratosthenes to list all primes in the range.
